description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to LXC container management, including network interface iteration, container configuration, and container lifecycle control within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces of an LXC container.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container with methods for lifecycle management and configuration.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Container configuration class with nested ConfigItem class for key-value pairs.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config::ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents a single configuration key-value pair for the container.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages creation and lifecycle of LXC containers within the system.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network interface.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with configuration.
